A rollback

observations.why: Aphoristic, identity-level formulation stated as bedrock — the matched-clause structure ('is a rollback we do not actually have') treats the position as constitutive, not argued for. No hedging, no opening for evidence to move it.
A performed declarative recording the settled cadence — ratification through a formalized field entry, not an assertion being defended.
